prompt:
Create a 3x1 sprite sheet for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG: one MONSTER in three battle poses.

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: three cells on white. In each cell the light-grey box shows where the monster stands and how big it is, the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the monster faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Draw the SAME monster once in every cell, filling its box. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, flat shading with 2-3 tones per colour and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero; it is a different character.

Image 3 is an APPROVED MONSTER sheet from this same game (a DIFFERENT monster, idle | attack | hurt): match its sprite-pixel size, rendering, shading, outline weight and level of detail, and how much the poses move. Do NOT copy that monster's body, colours or equipment.

Render as true pixel art: the monster about 96-120 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients.

Monster: a living pillar of flame with a molten glowing core in its chest, the fire shaped into a tall figure with two flame arms, the flames orange, yellow and deep red with crisp black outlines, the lower part tapering into a flickering point; it hovers, nothing touches the ground; in every cell it floats at the same height in its box with clear empty space below it, well above the bottom of the box, centred in its own cell. Keep every detail identical in every cell. FACE: a fierce face formed from the flame itself (two bright yellow eyes and a dark open mouth), no human skin.

Cells:
- left cell: idle, a ready battle stance facing right.
- middle cell: attack, surging forward toward the heroes, both flame arms reaching out with the elbows bent so they stay well inside the middle cell, the flames streaming back, at the same height as in the idle cell, facing right.
- right cell: hurt, knocked back, the flames flattened and streaming back, the arms thrown up, at the same height, still burning in the same bright orange, yellow and red as in the idle cell, recoiling away from the heroes (leaning left), still facing right.

MOVEMENT: the attack and hurt cells are dramatic ACTION frames, not static stances. Keep the figure upright and level in every cell, its lower point at the same height as in the idle cell: in the attack it surges forward to the right, leaning only its upper body and arms toward the heroes; in the hurt it is knocked back to the left and tilted back by about fifteen degrees; it always hovers, nothing touches the ground; the flames and trailing parts move with the motion. Each of the three silhouettes must be clearly different. BODY: in every cell, hovering above the ground, nothing touches the ground, no shadow, no water. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

One monster per cell and nothing else: no props on the ground, no effects outside the monster, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no floor, no shadows, no borders.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, skin, a human body, legs, a rock body, smoke, sparks outside the body, fireballs, a ground fire, dull brown colours.
